defects.source_says: EO 12415 (48 FR 15117, held text EO_12415.txt) amends section 4(b) of EO 12358 to read "The Commission shall terminate on December 31,1983." The first end on the claim's own theory is 1983-12-31; 1980-12-31 also predates this order's signing (1982-08-05) and the parent (1982-04-14).
Same source fixes termination at December 31, 1983; whole_order_end must equal the latest clause first end, which on the cited evidence is 1983-12-31.

defects.field: operative_clauses[0].judgment_reason / research_rationale vs first_end.date and whole_order_end.date
defects.claim_says: judgment_reason and research_rationale record the first end as 1983-12-31, while the structured first_end and whole_order_end give 1980-12-31
defects.source_says: The claim is internally inconsistent; the structured dates contradict both the cited source and the claim's own reasoning.

evidence_checked: Re-hashed jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12376.txt (b21c908e...), EO_12415.txt (0c5698b1...), EO_12553.txt (6361bdc5...): all match text_sha256; every quoted span equals the bytes at char_start:char_end.

EO 12376 identity: 47 FR 34349, signed August 5, 1982, Presidential Commission on Drunk Driving; one operative paragraph amending second sentence of section 1 of EO 12358 to 28 members. Inventory of one clause is complete.

Parent EO 12358 held text (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12358.txt): section 1 provides no more than 26 members; section 4(b) terminates the Commission one year from April 14, 1982; EO 12415 (April 5, 1983) replaced it before it operated.
EO 12553 table (51 FR 7242) lists 12358, 12376 and 12415 as revoked, signed February 25, 1986.

OFR catalog (jobs/later-events/output/CATALOG_INDEX.csv): EO 12376 'Amends: EO 12358 | Revoked by: EO 12553, February 25, 1986'; EO 12358 'Amended by: EO 12376; EO 12415 | Revoked by: EO 12553'. EDGES.csv shows no other acting instrument.
cruden number search EO:12376 (1 hit, the order itself) and EO:12358 (hits only in 12358, 12376, 12415 texts); no extension of the Commission beyond 1983-12-31 found.
reasoning: The legal theory is sound and matches the held sources: the 28-member ceiling lives in section 1 of EO 12358 and ends with the Commission, which EO 12415 set to terminate on December 31, 1983; EO 12553 of 1986-02-25 is the formal revocation, correctly recorded as a later event; no savings or later extension is held, and the 'Revoked by' note is addressed. But the structured first_end.date and whole_order_end.date both say 1980-12-31, a date before the order or its parent existed, which contradicts the cited EO 12415 text and the claim's own judgment_reason and research_rationale (1983-12-31). A wrong end date would enter the ready count, so the claim is rejected.
